text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d be glad to help connect your Pine Script strategy to MetaTrader so it can place trades automatically through your OctaFX account on your RDP.

I have 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, and API-based automation, and I’m comfortable building practical systems that connect different platforms and handle real-world workflows reliably. For this kind of task, I’d focus on making sure the signal flow is clean: your TradingView/Pine Script logic, the execution layer, and the MetaTrader side all need to communicate correctly so the trades are triggered as intended.

One relevant project I’ve built is a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. It was a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context. The result was that 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent, and the system achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That project required careful API integration, dependable automation, and handling user-driven actions smoothly, which is the same kind of discipline I’d bring to your trading setup.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, pandas, XGBoost, and machine learning, but for this job the main value I’d provide is strong Python/API integration and a practical approach to automation. I’m used to taking a working logic source and connecting it to an external execution environment in a way that is stable and easy to maintain.

If needed, I can help review the current Pine Script flow, identify how the trade signals should be passed to MetaTrader, and implement the connection so your broker setup can execute trades automatically.

What version of MetaTrader are you using, and do you already have a preferred bridge method for sending Pine Script signals into it?
